mapper.insert: INSERT INTO floor_plan (title, description, status, content_json, is_deleted, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{status}, #{contentJson}, 0, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE floor_plan SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, content_json = #{contentJson}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE floor_plan SET is_deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, description, status, content_json, is_deleted, create_time, update_time FROM floor_plan WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

is_deleted = 0

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO floor_plan_item (item_uid, type, x, y, w, h, rotation, label, color, venue_id, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{itemUid}, #{type}, #{x}, #{y}, #{w}, #{h}, #{rotation}, #{label}, #{color}, #{venueId}, NOW(), NOW())
INSERT INTO floor_plan_item_rel (floor_plan_id, floor_plan_item_id, create_time) VALUES (#{floorPlanId}, #{floorPlanItemId}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.item_uid, i.type, i.x, i.y, i.w, i.h, i.rotation, i.label, i.color, i.venue_id, i.create_time, i.update_time FROM floor_plan_item_rel r INNER JOIN floor_plan_item i ON i.id = r.floor_plan_item_id WHERE r.floor_plan_id = #{floorPlanId} ORDER BY r.id ASC

SELECT i.id, i.item_uid, i.type, i.x, i.y, i.w, i.h, i.rotation, i.label, i.color, i.venue_id, i.create_time, i.update_time FROM floor_plan_item_rel r INNER JOIN floor_plan_item i ON i.id = r.floor_plan_item_id WHERE r.floor_plan_id = #{floorPlanId} AND (i.venue_id IS NULL OR (#{venueId} IS NOT NULL AND i.venue_id = #{venueId})) ORDER BY r.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE floor_plan_item SET type = #{type}, x = #{x}, y = #{y}, w = #{w}, h = #{h}, rotation = #{rotation}, label = #{label}, color = #{color}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, item_uid, type, x, y, w, h, rotation, label, color, venue_id, create_time, update_time FROM floor_plan_item WHERE item_uid = #{itemUid} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, item_uid, type, x, y, w, h, rotation, label, color, venue_id, create_time, update_time FROM floor_plan_item WHERE venue_id = #{venueId} LIMIT 1

mapper.update: UPDATE floor_plan_item SET venue_id = #{venueId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{itemId} AND (venue_id IS NULL OR venue_id = #{venueId})
UPDATE floor_plan_item SET venue_id = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE venue_id = #{venueId}
mapper.delete: DELETE i FROM floor_plan_item i INNER JOIN floor_plan_item_rel r ON r.floor_plan_item_id = i.id WHERE r.floor_plan_id = #{floorPlanId}
